description:
At d-Matrix, we are focused on unleashing the potential of generative AI to power the transformation of technology. We are at the forefront of software and hardware innovation, pushing the boundaries of what is possible. Our culture is one of respect and collaboration.

We value humility and believe in direct communication. Our team is inclusive, and our differing perspectives allow for better solutions. We are seeking individuals passionate about tackling challenges and are driven by execution.  Ready to come find your playground? Together, we can help shape the endless possibilities of AI. 

Senior Infrastructure Engineer
Location: Remote, United States

Role Overview

Software Infrastructure runs the Kubernetes clusters, CI/CD systems, and compute environments that every d-Matrix engineer builds and tests on, along with the systems behind our externally accessible product demos. As a senior infrastructure engineer, you will be the team’s first responder and own issues end to end: diagnosing them, fixing them, and engaging IT or the product software group when the root cause sits with them. Our environment combines cloud resources, conventional servers, and our own AI accelerators and networking hardware, so quickly isolating the cause is central to the job. When an issue recurs, you will turn it into automation, better alerting, or a runbook. This is not an IT support or ticket-queue role, and IT owns physical hardware; we manage everything from the operating system up. On-call participation is expected.

What You Will Do

  • Own first response and resolution for issues across Kubernetes clusters, GitLab and CI runners, VMs, standalone systems, and demo environments

  • Triage across teams with IT and the product software group when the root cause sits on their side

  • Convert recurring issues into automation, alerts, and runbooks so repeat incidents decline

  • Improve monitoring and alerting to reduce false alarms and speed detection of real problems

  • Perform routine operational work, including upgrades, patching, certificate renewals, and capacity checks

  • Ship automation and improvements the team relies on, beyond individual fixes

  • Participate in on-call coverage for the environment

  • Contribute to design and build work across the team’s systems as your scope grows

What You Will Bring

  • 2+ years operating production Linux systems, including hands-on Kubernetes troubleshooting

  • Methodical debugging skills: forming hypotheses, narrowing them quickly, and working across layers when the obvious answer is wrong

  • Scripting experience in Python and/or Bash

  • Familiarity with CI/CD systems (GitLab preferred)

  • Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including DNS, routing, load balancing, and TLS

  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools

  • Clear communication under pressure, including concise incident status updates

  • Drive and curiosity to learn unfamiliar systems and how state-of-the-art inference systems are built

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with GPU or accelerator nodes in Kubernetes

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Ansible or Terraform

  • Experience with monitoring platforms such as DataDog, Prometheus, or Grafana

  • Bare metal or on-prem infrastructure experience

  • CKA or CKAD certification

Equal Opportunity Employment Policy

d-Matrix is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcomed and empowered to do their best work. We hire the best talent for our teams, regardless of race, religion, color, age, disability, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, genetic information, marital status, national origin, political affiliation, or veteran status. Our focus is on hiring teammates with humble expertise, kindness, dedication and a willingness to embrace challenges and learn together every day.

d-Matrix does not accept resumes or candidate submissions from external agencies. We appreciate the interest and effort of recruitment firms, but we kindly request that individual interested in opportunities with d-Matrix apply directly through our official channels. This approach allows us to streamline our hiring processes and maintain a consistent and fair evaluation of al applicants. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
